name: norange-vpn
description: NOrange — Tactical VPN, Shareable Hotspot VPN, HTTP/SOCKS5 Proxy Server, WebSocket Anti-Spyware Detector, Mock GPS & Real-Time Virtual Camera Suite. Desenvolvido por Diego Oris (diegooris.ch)

scripts.start:android: export PATH="$HOME/develop/flutter/bin:$HOME/Android/Sdk/platform-tools:$HOME/Android/Sdk/emulator:$PATH" && (adb devices | grep -q 'emulator-' || (rm -f ~/.android/avd/*.avd/*.lock && nohup emulator -avd Pixel_7 -no-snapshot-load -gpu auto -no-audio >/tmp/emulator_pixel7.log 2>&1 &)) && adb wait-for-device && until [ "$(adb shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')" = "1" ]; do sleep 2; done && flutter run -d emulator-5554
scripts.start:ios: export PATH="$HOME/develop/flutter/bin:$PATH" && open -a Simulator && sleep 3 && flutter run -d ios
scripts.emulator:android: export PATH="$HOME/develop/flutter/bin:$HOME/Android/Sdk/platform-tools:$HOME/Android/Sdk/emulator:$PATH" && (adb devices | grep -q 'emulator-' && echo 'Emulador já está aberto!' || (rm -f ~/.android/avd/*.avd/*.lock && nohup emulator -avd Pixel_7 -no-snapshot-load -gpu auto -no-audio >/tmp/emulator_pixel7.log 2>&1 & echo 'Iniciando emulador Pixel_7 (modo GPU estável)...'))
scripts.emulator:open: export PATH="$HOME/develop/flutter/bin:$HOME/Android/Sdk/platform-tools:$HOME/Android/Sdk/emulator:$PATH" && (adb devices | grep -q 'emulator-' || (rm -f ~/.android/avd/*.avd/*.lock && nohup emulator -avd Pixel_7 -no-snapshot-load -gpu auto -no-audio >/tmp/emulator_pixel7.log 2>&1 &))
scripts.emulator:open:playstore: export PATH="$HOME/develop/flutter/bin:$HOME/Android/Sdk/platform-tools:$HOME/Android/Sdk/emulator:$PATH" && (adb devices | grep -q 'emulator-' || (rm -f ~/.android/avd/*.avd/*.lock && nohup emulator -avd Pixel_7_PlayStore -no-snapshot-load -gpu swiftshader_indirect -no-audio >/tmp/emulator_pixel7_playstore.log 2>&1 &))
scripts.build:apk: export PATH="$HOME/develop/flutter/bin:$HOME/Android/Sdk/platform-tools:$PATH" && flutter build apk --release && mkdir -p releases && cp build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk releases/NOrange-universal-release.apk
scripts.build:apk:split: export PATH="$HOME/develop/flutter/bin:$HOME/Android/Sdk/platform-tools:$PATH" && flutter build apk --split-per-abi --release && mkdir -p releases && cp build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-arm64-v8a-release.apk releases/NOrange-arm64-v8a-release.apk && cp build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-armeabi-v7a-release.apk releases/NOrange-armeabi-v7a-release.apk && cp build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-x86_64-release.apk releases/NOrange-x86_64-release.apk
scripts.build:apk:all: npm run build:apk && npm run build:apk:split
scripts.install:apk: export PATH="$HOME/develop/flutter/bin:$HOME/Android/Sdk/platform-tools:$HOME/Android/Sdk/emulator:$PATH" && (adb devices | grep -qE 'device$' || (rm -f ~/.android/avd/*.avd/*.lock && nohup emulator -avd Pixel_7 -no-snapshot-load -gpu auto -no-audio >/tmp/emulator_pixel7.log 2>&1 &)) && echo 'Aguardando emulador/dispositivo ficar pronto...' && adb wait-for-device && until [ "$(adb shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')" = "1" ]; do sleep 2; done && adb install -r build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk && adb shell am force-stop com.harshRajpurohit.freeVpn && adb shell am start -n com.harshRajpurohit.freeVpn/.MainActivity
scripts.install:apk:release: export PATH="$HOME/develop/flutter/bin:$HOME/Android/Sdk/platform-tools:$HOME/Android/Sdk/emulator:$PATH" && (adb devices | grep -qE 'device$' || (rm -f ~/.android/avd/*.avd/*.lock && nohup emulator -avd Pixel_7 -no-snapshot-load -gpu auto -no-audio >/tmp/emulator_pixel7.log 2>&1 &)) && echo 'Aguardando emulador/dispositivo ficar pronto...' && adb wait-for-device && until [ "$(adb shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')" = "1" ]; do sleep 2; done && adb install -r build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk && adb shell am force-stop com.harshRajpurohit.freeVpn && adb shell am start -n com.harshRajpurohit.freeVpn/.MainActivity
scripts.clean: export PATH="$HOME/develop/flutter/bin:$PATH" && flutter clean && flutter pub get
